text: An investor asked when the HCP-04 final capital call fell due. The assistant gave the 2026-09-17 due date and cited the HCP-04 notice.
A limited partner asked about the Call 11 amount for HCP-02. The assistant quoted 1.5 percent of commitment, notice 2026-10-05, due 2026-10-19.
An investor in HCP-01 asked what Call 9 was for. The assistant explained follow-on investments and the Q4 fee, and pointed to the notice on the portal.
An investor asked for tax treatment of a distribution. The assistant declined to give tax advice and pointed to their own adviser.
A limited partner asked whether a wire sent at 16:10 on the due date counted as on time. The assistant explained the 15:00 cut-off and referred the case to the desk.
An investor in HCP-03 asked about the new Call 4. The assistant gave 8.5 percent, due 2026-11-16, purpose new loans and expenses.
An investor asked when Q3 statements would appear. The assistant said 45 days after quarter end, so by 2026-11-14.
A limited partner asked to sell part of an interest in HCP-04. The assistant explained the consent and 30 day notice rule and the 2,500 USD fee.
An investor asked what the HCP-02 distribution split meant. The assistant explained 70 percent return of capital and 30 percent gains.
An investor asked the HCP-04 distribution payment date. The assistant gave the record date and payment date from the notice.
